title_en: Oni Press' Crownsville Is One of 2025's Coolest Horror Comics, and Now You Can Read the Entire First Chapter for Free
summary_en: Oni Press' Crownsville is a truly haunting horror comic with a real historical legacy, and now you can read the entire first chapter for free.
body_en:
Oni Press' Crownsville was easily one of the most exciting new horror comics of 2025 , given that it's written by Killadelphia's Rodney Barnes and delves into a dark piece of American history. Now the entire series has been released and is about to be published in trade paperback form. To celebrate, IGN can exclusively offer the entire first issue of the series for free.
Head down to the slideshow gallery below to read Crownsville #1 for yourself:
Crownsville is a five-issue limited series written by Barnes and illustrated by Elia Bonetti (Death of Wolverine: The Logan Legacy). The trade paperback features cover art by Andrea Sorrentino (Old Man Logan). Here's the official summary of the series:
The Crownsville trade paperback will be released on Tuesday, August 11. You can order a copy on Amazon .
For more, check out a preview of the Marvel Artist Archive: Jim Lee hardcover and learn more about Black Panther/Namor: Doomed .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
